io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.accessModel: OAuth 2.1 with mandatory PKCE (S256). Alternatively (JX-MCP-079C) the same access key works directly per call for clients whose OAuth callback is blocked: Authorization: Bearer <access key> or X-Jithox-Api-Key — never both. Treat a key in client config like a password; rotate/revoke at jithox.com.
boundaries: This server never places, modifies or cancels an order, never completes or cancels a checkout, and never touches a payment or card data — the merchant stays merchant of record.
Comparisons are value tables on a stated criterion — never a ranking sold as advice.

Prices, availability and checkout data are the queried source's own declarations at the stated time, never a guarantee they still hold; 'verified' means internally consistent, never 'safe' or 'approved'.
The current official ACP checkout spec is REST-only; no ACP-over-MCP capability is claimed.
No independent penetration test has been performed.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.commercialStatus: NOT_OFFERED — endpoint public and live, sale withheld until a retail source is connected. Never read as adoption.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.marketCoverage: Per connected source; every answer declares the markets it covers. The capability is market-agnostic.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Not offered for sale yet. A candidate price is recorded and activates nothing.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.remoteDeployment: Single public HTTPS endpoint operated by Jithox.

toolDescriptions.build_affiliate_buy_link: Return the provider's official product link for a HUMAN to click. Never a checkout URL; nothing is ordered.
toolDescriptions.compare_product_offers: Compare 2-5 EANs as a value table ordered by a stated criterion. A table, never advice.
toolDescriptions.get_commerce_readiness: Which commerce provider is configured, which protocols this deployment speaks (UCP discovery + negotiation; the ACP REST checkout format), and what each still needs before live evidence exists.
toolDescriptions.get_product_offer: One product's current offer — or, given a merchant host + itemId, normalized UCP/ACP checkout evidence (items, currency, totals breakdown, fulfillment, policy links, expiry, evidence hash) with bounded truth states verified/changed/unsupported/unavailable/unverified and change detection between preparation and re-check.
toolDescriptions.search_retail_products: Search retail products by free text or EAN against the queried source; deterministic match kinds, visible ambiguity.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.toolStatus: LIVE_BUT_SOURCE_NOT_CONNECTED — every source-backed tool returns a truthful not_configured that costs nothing until a real merchant source (UCP/ACP) or partner catalog is connected.

access.chargingRule: Only accepted calls are charged. Refusals, invalid input, authentication failures, rate limits, provider outages and 'unavailable' answers cost nothing.
access.freeTrial: 25 accepted calls, 14 days, no card required — https://mcp.jithox.com/onboarding/free
access.paid: Prepaid only: €0.10 per ACCEPTED call, fixed top-up tiers from €10 (100 calls) to €500 (5000 calls). No subscription, no automatic renewal, no overage, no automatic top-up — when prepaid calls run out, calls are refused.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE S256; discover at https://mcp.jithox.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Or send the workspace access key per call as Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-Jithox-Api-Key — never both. A key in a config file is a password; rotate at jithox.com.
boundaries: Jithox does not send invoices through this MCP; send_peppol_invoice does not exist.
A readiness answer describes what the consulted sources returned at the stated time. It is not a legal, fiscal or compliance statement.
The tools do not combine into a single counterparty verdict — each check is its own tool and the agent decides what the combination means.
A negative answer means one source returned no match at that moment, never that a company is unregistered or non-compliant.
Provider outages produce 'unavailable', never a guessed verdict.
No independent penetration test has been performed.
x402 / agent-initiated payment is NOT available in production: human approval is required for every purchase.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.commercialStatus: LIVE_TECHNICAL_BETA — self-service: free trial, then prepaid usage.
